correctness.rationale: The published formula for nu_2(F_m) yields s(n)=1_{6|n+1}h(nu_2(n+1)). Every 4-kernel offset is classified: nonexceptional offsets are zero or constant multiples of a residue indicator mod 3, while the exceptional offset gives g+e delta_2. Explicit kernel elements generate all five sequences, and evaluation at n=0,1,2,5,11 proves their linear independence. Thus the generated module has rank exactly 5. The finite verifier checks the identities but is not used as the infinite proof.
